# What each design of the timing corpus is made of and how deep its logic is,
# every figure Vivado 2026.1's counting at xc7a100tftg256-3:
# tools/vivado-parity/netlist_qor.sh and `netlist_qor.py table --fixture`;
# docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Synthesis against Vivado's". Run on 2026-11-06.
#   vivado   Vivado's synth_design of the design, nothing after
#   before   Reticle's netlist of seed 1 of the `after` build of achieved.txt
#            (which is 04b70219's flow with the placement changes, and the
#            netlist `--synthesis legacy` makes), linked unplaced
#   after    Reticle's netlist of seed 1 of the `synthesis` build, the default
#            `--synthesis vivado`
#   area     Reticle's netlist of seed 1 of the `area` build of achieved.txt, the
#            default with docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md's "Area against Vivado's"
#            (2026-11-07)
#   cells <build> <design> <LUT> <CARRY4> <FF> <MUXF7> <MUXF8>
#   levels <build> <design> <clock> <max> <worst> <tables> <CARRY4s>
#            the most levels of logic on any of the clock's paths to itself in
#            the 5,000 worst, and the levels of its worst setup path with how
#            many are tables and how many CARRY4s. Reticle's tables include the
#            ones `xray::legalise_carries` puts in front of a chain.
